annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 as regards uniform procedures and technical specifications for the type-approval of the automated driving system (ADS) of fully automated vehicles
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 as regards uniform procedures and technical specifications for the type-approval of the automated driving system (ADS) of fully automated vehicles
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 221/1
annotation.summary_en: EU implementing regulation setting uniform type-approval procedures and technical specifications for automated driving systems of fully automated vehicles (M and N categories) in predefined-area, hub-to-hub and valet-parking use cases. It requires performance tests, safety management system audits, virtual-toolchain credibility assessment, event data recording and in-service reporting.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to type-approval of ADS of fully automated M and N category vehicles for predefined-area, hub-to-hub and automated valet parking use cases.
ADS must perform the entire dynamic driving task, execute minimal risk manoeuvres, and be free of unreasonable risk compared to manual driving.
In unavoidable harm situations, no weighting by personal characteristics, and outside lives not subordinated to occupants.
Manufacturers need a certified safety management system, cybersecurity (UN R155) and software update (UN R156) compliance.
Mandatory event data recording and in-service reporting of critical occurrences to authorities and the Commission.
